title: A/R Collection: the top-left chevron collapses and expands every group
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure that at least three customers have overdue invoices on today's date.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu).
  • Leave the report with every group collapsed.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the chevron on one customer group row.
  2. Hover over the chevron button in the table's top-left header cell.
  3. Click that chevron button.
  4. Hover over the chevron button again.
  5. Click it.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • That customer group expands.
  • Its own chevron turns from pointing right to pointing down.

Step 2:

  • The button's chevron points down (a group is expanded).
  • A tooltip above the button reads "Collapse all".

Step 3:

  • Every group collapses.
  • The column under the button was not sorted: the sort mark is still on the column the report opened on.

Step 4:

  • The chevron now points right.
  • The tooltip reads "Expand all".

Step 5:

  • Every group expands.
  • The column under the button is still not sorted.
  • Every customer group row's own chevron points down (open).

This release does not change how the groups open, so they open as today; the starting screen asks for every group collapsed, collapsing any that are open.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows)

  • S4-R1: “The table's top-left header cell holds one chevron button. While any group is expanded it points down, its tooltip (above the button) reads "Collapse all", and a click collapses every group. When every group is collapsed it points right, its tooltip reads "Expand all", and a click expands every group.”
  • S4-R3: “Clicking the button never sorts the column under it.”
  • S4-R5: “Each group's own expand toggle uses the same chevron: pointing down when open, right when closed. Behavior is unchanged.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Collapse all / Expand all button | "Collapse all" / "Expand all" | Tooltip above the button”
